# Soundtrace

> > Soundtrace is the gold standard digital platform for OSHA hearing conservation, combining audiometric testing, noise monitoring, fit testing, and recordkeeping in one cloud-based solution.

Soundtrace provides comprehensive hearing conservation compliance tools for employers, featuring proprietary Invisible Booth™ technology for boothless audiometric testing and real-time IoT-enabled noise monitoring. The platform helps organizations meet 29 CFR 1910.95 requirements while protecting employee hearing health.

## Key Topics

- OSHA 1910.95 Hearing Conservation Standard
- Audiometric Testing
- Invisible Booth™ Technology
- Noise Monitoring (IoT/SaaS)
- Fit Testing (Fit Check+)
- Recordkeeping & Compliance
- STS Detection
- Workplace Safety
- Occupational Health
- Digital Audiogram
- Hearing Loss Prevention
- HIPAA & SOC 2 Compliance
- Real-time Monitoring
- Employee Training

## Core Platform Features

- [Soundtrace - The Gold Standard in OSHA Hearing Conservation](https://www.soundtrace.com): Soundtrace digital platform for OSHA hearing conservation combining audiometric testing, fit testing, noise monitoring, and recordkeeping.
- [Audiometric Testing | Soundtrace - Digital Hearing Conservation](https://www.soundtrace.com/feature/audiometric-testing): OSHA-compliant audiometric testing with Invisible Booth™ technology for digital hearing tests and STS detection.
- [Noise Monitoring | Soundtrace - Digital Hearing Conservation](https://www.soundtrace.com/feature/noise-monitoring): Real-time noise monitoring IoT and SaaS solution for OSHA compliance and employee safety with cloud platform.
- [Ear Plug Fit Testing](https://www.soundtrace.com/feature/fit-testing): Fit Check+ earplug fit testing for OSHA 1910.95 compliance with accurate PAR ratings and traceable records.
- [Recordkeeping | Soundtrace - Digital Hearing Conservation](https://www.soundtrace.com/feature/recordkeeping): Cloud-based recordkeeping solution for OSHA hearing conservation program documentation and compliance.
- [Features | Soundtrace - Digital Hearing Conservation](https://www.soundtrace.com/features): Overview of Soundtrace platform features including noise monitoring, audiometric testing, and recordkeeping.

## OSHA Compliance & Guidance

- [OSHA 1910.95: The Complete Employer Guide to the Hearing Conservation Standard](https://www.soundtrace.com/blog/osha-1910-95-hearing-conservation-standard-complete-guide): Comprehensive guide to 29 CFR 1910.95 covering noise limits, audiometric testing, STS response, and recordkeeping.
- [OSHA Hearing Conservation Program | Annual Checklist](https://www.soundtrace.com/osha-hearing-conservation-program-annual-checklist): Free annual compliance checklist for OSHA hearing conservation program requirements and employee health.
- [Annual Hearing Conservation Training | Soundtrace](https://www.soundtrace.com/annual-hearing-conservation-training): OSHA 1910.95 annual training covering noise exposure, hearing protection, and employee rights.
